title: Market Drops Almost 600 Points: Watch Our Team Explain What You Need to do Now

organizations.name: trump rips amazon again on twitter   plus saks fifth avenue and lord & taylor

text:
Stocks plunged this morning, the first trading day of the second quarter, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq both falling into correction territory after China's Ministry of Finance announced new tariffs of up to 25% on U.S. products such as pork, fruit, nuts and wine.
Tech stocks in particular are taking it in the chin as Facebook Inc. ( FB ) Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) and Netflix ( NFLX ) Inc. all saw steep drops.
Should you buy those stocks for retirement?  Read this! And Amazon ( AMZN ) is back in the crosshairs as President Trump continues his assault on the eCommerce king on via Twitter ( TWTR ) . 
President Trump Rips Amazon Again on Twitter   Plus Saks Fifth Avenue and Lord & Taylor suffered data breaches, with information stolen for more than 5 million credit and debit cards used at the department stores.
So watch Tracy Byrnes, Kinsey Grant and Brian Sozzi explain what's happening and even offer a retirement tip.
